previewOwner: Architect; this packet retains no preview
steps: Open the ordinary built Editor. In Foliage playtest choose Open foliage test ground, and allow its same-origin popup.
Back in the Editor choose Load connected foliage blueprint. Stay on the ground floor and local cells x=0–15, y=0–15; pan/zoom to that corner if needed.

Use the normal Foliage palette. The reviewed corridor uses woodland-v1, passable cover, density 80 and rectangle x=5–11, y=10–12. Erase and repaint it to try a changed map; undo/redo and ordinary save/open remain available.
Choose Preflight connected game, then Send to game. Read the acceptance/refusal status; the authored document and history remain retained.
In Night Ledger close open panels, then use WASD/arrows or the joystick. Sneak changes noise behavior; Prone followed by movement crawls; Stand returns upright.

Open the map panel to read stance, awareness, heard events, concealment and foliage revision. Close it before moving again. Awareness and heard events retain their history, so compare new observations rather than expecting old events to disappear.

In Fixtures & golden checks select Foliage changes confirmed stealth outcomes and Run selected. Its controlled authored-map comparison checks lower brush awareness and fewer Sneak hearing events. Clearing the brush may intentionally fail the brush-advantage expectation.
Use Save sandbox and Reload save after moving or changing stance to review retained pose and spent resources.
limits: One flat normal-goat plot; hands or original rifle.
Passable cover does not remove source trunk-cell blocking; the documented 1.4 m body envelope remains conservative.
Density marks, observer and shot contacts are diagnostic.
